title: Pasting the native scalar tensor summand diagram
statement: For the actual diagram D of finite R, p:X→Y, P,Q and a+b=n, the source injection followed by the three left total edges equals that injection followed by the right total edge: D.j0 ≫ D.l1 ≫ D.l2 ≫ D.l3 = D.j0 ≫ D.right.

proof.text: Use the fixed, realization and tensor-map field equations successively. Associativity identifies the left total path on an injection with the ordinary left path followed by the target injection.
Substitute the ordinary square and reverse the right field equation. The pure categorical pasting proof and its native application are complete Lean proofs; no new hole is introduced here.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteScalarTensorDiagram_commutes
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ)
    (a b n : ℤ) (h : a + b = n) :
    let D := finiteScalarTensorSummandDiagram R p P Q a b n h
    D.j0 ≫ D.l1 ≫ D.l2 ≫ D.l3 = D.j0 ≫ D.right
